title: Aaron Spradlin
dek: Signal over hype. The public claim is a coherent AI-research ledger — not a physics or math discovery.
text:
Coherence and AI research. A public ledger you can audit: freeze, ship, attack, badge. He is not claiming a physics result, a math theorem of nature, gravity, or a solved folding problem. scientific_breakthrough: false.

Aaron Spradlin (@aaronspradlin) is Chief Technology & Security Officer at United Planners Financial Services. The X bio is the governing self-description: practical AI, cybersecurity, enterprise innovation, and first-principles research. The motto is the product: signal over hype.

Signal over hype

The habit is the same on the day-job track and the research track: do not sell a headline the package cannot carry. Industry posts credit the team, not a solo genius. Research posts end with the non-claim. Exact model results and runnable verification are not measured physics. A closed constraint algebra is not a derivation of gravity. Same pair information is not a discovery of hidden quantum information in general.

This is not a claim that Astra derived gravity. Gravity’s constraints have not been identified yet.

What the public claim actually is

Coherence — one compiled spine, claim badges, a falsification page, two clocks that must not be merged, and a working tree that is not the front door.
AI research — Grok, Astra, Gemini, Claude, OpenAI used as red-team and lab partners, not oracles. In-thread checks stay collaborative. Independent AI check is a different family, folder-only.
A tool, not a TOE — the 7 Sep post asked others to open Grok Build and make their own ledger the same way.

Signal over hype. Compiled the public research with @grok Build into a wiki + app so nobody has to mine the working tree. Claim badges. Causal stack. Falsification page. Four Supported harnesses. Gravity still a candidate. Folding not solved. X remains the archive. Open Grok → Build Mode and make your own ledger the same way.

Why he is doing this

The research question is allowed to be large. The claim is not. He is testing whether structure can appear from retained information without inserting a manifold. AI is the instrument: freeze a packet, invite attack, keep the badge honest. Coherence is the thing he will defend in public — not Einstein, not a folding oracle.

Industry track (beside the research, not inside it)

31 Mar 2026: United Planners builds by listening — remove friction, keep the human relationship; not technology for its own sake. 5 Aug: Wealthies Institutional CTO of the Year nomination, credited to the team. 3 Sep: ThinkAdvisor Luminaries finalist, tied to making advisors more productive. Same motto. Different ledger.

Industry recognition does not select κ, close Pillar 3, or turn a Restricted harness into Supported. Day-job and Luminaries posts stay off the science ledger.
